messages.content: Predict this human participant's contribution to a public good. Four anonymous people interact through computers without communication. Each round each person receives a new endowment of 50 monetary units (MU). Choose an integer contribution c from 0 to 50 MU to the group account; 50-c stays private. Every contributed MU gives each of the four group members 0.5 MU, so own round earnings = 50-c + 0.5*(the sum of all four contributions). Actual earnings are accumulated and paid privately in cash at the end. Contributions and predictions are in MU. Before play everyone correctly answered the rule/composition control questions. After each completed round contributions within the group are shown ranked highest to lowest, without stable participant identities; contributions in other groups are not shown. Previous own contributions, ranked anonymous other contributions and earnings calculable from these visible quantities are in prior_feedback. There is no current counterpart choice or future result in that history. You were told there are two blocks of 10 rounds. At the end of the first block groups are ranked by total earnings. The lowest-earning one of each three groups stops participating in the public goods game; its members only receive 50 MU each remaining round, irrespective of their similar placeholder task. The other groups continue with the same partners for 10 standard rounds with no further removal. You learn your own group rank band after the first block. state.current_round is the sequential round index, state.round_in_current_stage uses the currently announced game stage, and own_cumulative_prior_earnings_MU sums only past actual earnings. Output only the integer contribution 0–50, without explanation.

Every contributed MU gives each of the four group members 0.5 MU, so own round earnings = 50-c + 0.5*(the sum of all four contributions). Actual earnings are accumulated and paid privately in cash at the end. Contributions and predictions are in MU. Before play everyone correctly answered the rule/composition control questions. After each completed round contributions within the group are shown ranked highest to lowest, without stable participant identities; contributions in other groups are not shown. Previous own contributions, ranked anonymous other contributions and earnings calculable from these visible quantities are in prior_feedback. There is no current counterpart choice or future result in that history. After completing the initially announced 10 rounds, an unannounced restart offered another 10 rounds with the same three partners. You now know this restarted game ends after those 10 rounds. There is no ranking or removal. state.current_round is the sequential round index, state.round_in_current_stage uses the currently announced game stage, and own_cumulative_prior_earnings_MU sums only past actual earnings. Output only the integer contribution 0–50, without explanation.
